entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Anne Frank Zentrum, located in Berlin, is a history museum dedicated to Anne Frank and her diary. It contains exhibitions and an array of educational programs. The centre is committed to working against anti-Semitism, prejudice, and any kind of discrimination against people.
